approve() delegates to _approve().
deliver() obtains reflection values from _getValues().
deliver() subtracts rAmount from _rOwned[sender].
deliver() reduces _rTotal by rAmount.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter exists only to feed the core transfer routine; it can be folded into _transfer.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by _transfer and carries no independent security meaning.
The sender parameter is only consumed by _transfer and should be merged into it.
This local is the exact value handed to the external router swap call, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
The takeFee boolean only selects the branch inside _tokenTransfer.
The path array is constructed solely for the external swap call.
tAmount is the sole input of _getValues and its arithmetic helpers.
The account parameter is only used to add the account to the _excluded state array.
The maxTxAmount parameter is only written by the owner-only privileged setter.
